correctness.rationale: The conditional PMF is computed exactly from four Poisson masses; real-rooted Legendre generating polynomial yields independent-Bernoulli representation and a variance bound. Exact score identity yields 0<=nmu/(n+mu)-E_Q K<=1. Bessel mgf yields the reference CLT and exponential-moment control; the explicit monotone likelihood ratio produces a Gaussian tilt at mu^(3/2)/n=O(1), and its TV is the stated normal-shift profile. In the larger regime the two means differ by mu^2/n >> sqrt(mu), while both variances are O(mu), proving TV ->1. The standard-library checker passed 243 finite exact/numerical assertions; finite checks are supplemental.

value.rationale: The motivating conditional-Poisson fluctuation theory does not quantify singular-cost approximation. Determining exactly when an apparently natural Bessel approximation fails in the strong total-variation metric, including the \(n^{4/3}\) transition and nontrivial limiting profile, supplies a natural precise boundary for inferential approximation on a canonical small-margin contingency table. It is not a rephrased fixed-parameter Bessel weak limit or a purely numerical invariant.
